# Image experiment (COCO val2017 subset)

750 images (500 with people, 250 without), 10 conditions, input sizes 320, 416, 640. Decision threshold 0.5, match IoU 0.5. mAP is on this subset only and is not comparable to full val2017 numbers.

## Latency (detector call only, CPU, batch 1)

| imgsz | n | mean ms | median ms | p95 ms | images/s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 320 | 750 | 13.7 | 12.5 | 21.0 | 73.1 |
| 416 | 750 | 18.7 | 16.9 | 29.6 | 53.5 |
| 640 | 750 | 32.5 | 30.1 | 48.5 | 30.7 |

Spread of mean latency across the ten conditions: imgsz 320: 12.5–13.7 ms, imgsz 416: 17.1–18.7 ms, imgsz 640: 30.3–32.5 ms.

## Hypothesis checks (mechanical)

- H1, person AP, blur: decreases monotonically with severity at 3 of 3 input sizes.
- H1, person AP, low_light: decreases monotonically with severity at 3 of 3 input sizes.
- H1, person AP, noise: decreases monotonically with severity at 3 of 3 input sizes.
- H1, person R@0.5, blur: decreases monotonically with severity at 3 of 3 input sizes.
- H1, person R@0.5, low_light: decreases monotonically with severity at 3 of 3 input sizes.
- H1, person R@0.5, noise: decreases monotonically with severity at 3 of 3 input sizes.
- H1, imgsz 320: person AP at the strongest level, lowest first: blur 0.282, noise 0.324, low_light 0.374.
- H1, imgsz 416: person AP at the strongest level, lowest first: blur 0.290, noise 0.353, low_light 0.437.
- H1, imgsz 640: person AP at the strongest level, lowest first: blur 0.270, noise 0.356, low_light 0.517.
